title: Design: New Customer shows Credit Terms and Credit Limit side by side
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Due on Receipt is the default for new customers.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design pictures ct-p5-01-new-customer-today.png, ct-p5-02-new-customer-credit-terms-prefilled-with-the-def.png are attached to this case; open each at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Customer" window opens (as in ct-p5-02-new-customer-credit-terms-prefilled-with-the-def.png): after "State/Province" and "Country" comes one row with "Credit Terms" at the left, reading "Due on Receipt", and "Credit Limit" at the right, empty, the two boxes the same width as State/Province and Country above them; the Sales Representative field follows. Compared with today's picture ct-p5-01-new-customer-today.png only this row is new.
  • Step 2: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R1: “New Customer shows a "Credit Terms" dropdown and a "Credit Limit" field side by side, in the same place they sit on Edit Customer.”
  • S5-R2: “On New Customer, Credit Terms is prefilled with the shop's default.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "5 New Customer" ("New Customer today", "New Customer: Credit Terms prefilled with the default"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p5-01-new-customer-today.png
  • ct-p5-02-new-customer-credit-terms-prefilled-with-the-def.png

The design's own words:

  • “Credit Limit now sits beside it, as on Edit Customer, and starts blank (blank means no limit). Same gate as Credit Terms: View and Manage AP/AR Data.”
  • “Field order from CustomerDialog.vue on both branches: State/Province and Country, then Credit Terms (with Credit Limit beside it on Edit), then the Sales Representative field(s).”
